claims.claim: End-to-end task scores were the only agent quality signal; mid-run decision accuracy is now benchmarked and trainable.
claims.summary_span: End-to-end task scores were the only agent quality signal; mid-run decision accuracy is now benchmarked and trainable.
claims.source_span: While existing benchmarks measure the end-to-end success of agents on long-horizon tasks, none of them measures the taste of an agent... we show that taste can be trained.
claims.note: Both assertions — that end-to-end was the prior signal and that mid-run decision quality is now benchmarked and trainable — are directly supported by the source.
